svg.aria-label: GreenBranch's original CI/CD on AWS EC2. server-deploy.yaml (for server-ai/) and ec2-deploy.yaml (for server-ec2/) each had one job: log in to Docker Hub, build and push a linux/amd64 image, then use appleboy/ssh-action to write the .env from secrets, pull the image, and replace the container on that service's EC2 instance. No tests ran first and no health check ran after, so a broken image stayed live until the next deploy.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: ✕ No tests before the image was built and pushed
✕ No health check after docker run
✕ No rollback: a broken image stayed live
✕ No concurrency group: deploys could overlap
on: push → main · server-ai/** · one job: build-and-deploy
write .env · pull · stop · rm · run -p 8000 · prune
on: push → main · server-ec2/** · one job: build-and-deploy
write .env · pull · stop · rm · run -p 8001 + docker.sock · prune
only :latest, so no older image to go back to
